mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tw_h5_session(token, user_id, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.phone, u.password_hash passwordHash, u.salt, u.balance, u.free_views_remaining freeViewsRemaining, u.created_at createdAt, u.updated_at updatedAt, u.vip_level, u.vip_start_at, u.vip_expire_at FROM tw_h5_session s JOIN tw_h5_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token = #{token} AND s.expires_at > #{now} LIMIT 1
